name: Mouwasat Medical Services Company
summary: Mouwasat Medical Services Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the acquisition, management, operation, and maintenance of hospitals, medical centers, drug stores, and pharmacies in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates a network of hospitals that provides medical services and specialized centers, including eye, obesity, cardiology, diabetic, robotic, fertility, rehabilitation, long term care, stroke, and skincare center. It also provides various services comprising inpatient pharmacy services, TPN and IV medication preparation units, chemotherapy medication preparation, anti-coagulant clinic, and clinical pharmacy services.
